info.title: ADAMANT Node API
info.description:
OpenAPI 3.2 specification for the [ADAMANT](https://adamant.im) Node API.

ADAMANT is a decentralized messenger built on its own blockchain. This specification covers
accounts, transactions, chats, delegates, blocks, nodes, and key-value storage endpoints.

**Useful links**
- [ADAMANT Node](https://github.com/Adamant-im/adamant) — blockchain node implementation
- [AIPs](https://github.com/Adamant-im/AIPs) — ADAMANT Improvement Proposals
- [API Docs](https://docs.adamant.im) — reference documentation
- [OpenAPI JSON](/schema.json) — bundled specification
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Adamant-im/adamant-schema) — source of this specification

unixTimestampMs.description: Current node time measured in Unix milliseconds. This is node clock metadata and is not consensus data.

activationHeights.description: Effective runtime activation heights after configuration defaults, the selected configuration file, and startup overrides are merged. Values are network- and configuration-specific.

offset.description: First block height that receives a block reward.

distance.description: Number of block heights between reward milestones.

milestones.description: Block rewards by milestone in base units (1 ADM = 100000000).

PublicKey.description: 256 bit public key of ADAMANT address in hex format

balance.description: Confirmed ADM balance in 1/10^8 ADM units.

publicKey.description: 256 bit public key of the ADAMANT address in hex format, or `null` when the account has not published it yet.

username.description: Delegate username, or `null` when the account is not a delegate.

isDelegate.description: Whether the account is registered as a delegate.

timestamp.description: Transaction time specified by the sender, measured in seconds since the ADAMANT epoch.

timestampMs.description: Optional transaction time specified by the sender, measured in milliseconds since the ADAMANT epoch. Returned when a node has stored it; for blockchain consensus-sensitive data this works after the `spaceship` activation. When present, it belongs to the same second as `timestamp`, so clients should prefer it for timestamp ordering and fall back to `timestamp * 1000` when it is absent.

amount.description: Amount to transfer, 8 decimal points (100000000 equals to 1 ADM). For non-transfer transactions must be `0`

type.description: Type of chat message (1 - Basic Encrypted Message, 2 - Rich Content Message, 3 - Signal Message). See details https://github.com/Adamant-im/adamant/wiki/Message-Types

timestamp.description: Transaction time measured in seconds since the ADAMANT epoch.

timestampMs.description: Optional transaction time measured in milliseconds since the ADAMANT epoch. Supported by upgraded nodes and stored in consensus-sensitive transaction data after the `spaceship` activation. If provided, clients should derive `timestamp` from the same value using `Math.floor(timestampMs / 1000)`; `round` or `ceil` can create an invalid timestamp pair.

forged.description: Lifetime sum of block fees and rewards as a base-10 integer string in base units (1 ADM = 100000000).

timestampMs.description: Optional transaction time measured in milliseconds since the ADAMANT epoch. Available for transactions that include it; for consensus-sensitive blockchain storage it works after the `spaceship` activation. When present, it belongs to the same second as `timestamp`.

AddressSubscription.description: One ADAMANT address or a list of addresses. The node validates values at runtime and stores accepted addresses in uppercase; this schema does not perform that validation or normalization.

TransactionTypeSubscription.description: One transaction type or a list of transaction types to add to the socket subscription.

ChatTypeSubscription.description: One asset.chat.type value or a list of values to add to the socket subscription. This WebSocket contract follows the node's complete chat transaction type range (0-3), independently of REST chat endpoints that expose narrower query filters.

BalanceSubscription.description: One public balance field or a list of fields to add to the socket subscription. At least one address subscription is required before balance changes can be delivered.

BlockSubscription.description: A scalar boolean that enables or disables newBlock events for the socket.

BalanceChangeEvent.description: Current values for the subscribed public balance fields that changed. No initial snapshot is emitted. Values are decimal strings in 1/10^8 ADM units.

unconfirmedBalance.description: Account balance after applying the node's current unconfirmed pool.

NewBlockEvent.description: Compact header of a successfully applied and saved block. Historical database replay does not produce this event.

totalAmount.description: Total transferred amount in 1/10^8 ADM units.

totalFee.description: Total transaction fee in 1/10^8 ADM units.

type-2.name: type
type-2.description:
When sending KVS transaction, type field of state object must be as follows:

- `0` for full re-writing of contents by specified key value
- `1` for incremental appending contents

For more details see [AIP 11: Behavior for KVS data](https://aips.adamant.im/AIPS/aip-11)
